ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Access Tool - ScreenConnect Installation Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects ScreenConnect program starts that establish a remote access to a system.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*e\\=Access\\&.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*y\\=Guest\\&.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&p\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&c\\=.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&k\\=.*"))
